notes: UNTRAINED experiment configuration. Separate later source alternative. REFUGE and PAPILA are independent source-isolated experiments, never merged or automatically concatenated. Use REFUGE first; PAPILA is an independent later experiment, not continuation from a REFUGE-trained model. U-Net is randomly initialized (no pretrained backbone); 512x512, base_channels32, 50 epochs, per-GPU batch2 with gradient accumulation4 (effective batch16 on two GPUs). Preserve the original image/mask aligned stretch resize and matched augmentation; do not apply DR black-border crop/letterbox to segmentation images without the corresponding mask geometry. Validation/test evaluate the whole image resized to 512, not native-resolution/sliding-window metrics. All original source labels, expert selection, loss settings and audited splits are retained. No formal training or GPU benchmark has been performed for this experiment.
